text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Kikuka Sho, the final 
hurdle of the Classic Triple Crown, has 
finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Entering her prime after a crushing 
victory in the trial race, 
Matikanefukukitaru declares war on Mejiro 
Bright.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Against the embodiment of booming good 
fortune at its absolute peak, how far 
could Mejiro Bright's dormant stayer 
talent carry her?
